Hey,

[FREELANCER_NAME_004] to have you — at [FREELANCER_NAME_002] moment, you are one of just 2 clippers who have been hired. You are joining at [FREELANCER_NAME_002] very beginning, so you have a genuine opportunity to grow with this from day one.

Here are [FREELANCER_NAME_002] answers to [FREELANCER_NAME_005] questions:

**Videos you will edit:**
You will work with Teyron Alexina's long-form YouTube videos. Watch them, identify self-contained moments — such as a complete lesson, a story, or a real point — and make each one into a standalone 45-60 second clip for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok.

**Timing for [FREELANCER_NAME_002] 100 clips:**
[FREELANCER_NAME_002] target is 100 approved clips each month, which works out to approximately 3-4 clips per day. Maintaining consistent daily output will keep you on schedule.

**Payment details:**
For 100 approved clips, [FREELANCER_NAME_002] monthly retainer is $400-500. A clip counts as approved only after I personally review and approve it; only those clips count toward [FREELANCER_NAME_002] 100. You can also earn performance bonuses based on how [FREELANCER_NAME_005] clips do on Instagram, including up to $500 for a single clip that blows up. This means [FREELANCER_NAME_005] earning potential is considerably higher than [FREELANCER_NAME_002] flat fee.

Tomorrow, I will provide everything you need: [FREELANCER_NAME_002] full training material, [FREELANCER_NAME_002] guidelines, and [FREELANCER_NAME_002] Instagram account assigned to you. Be prepared.

We are only getting started. Let us crush this.

[CLIENT_NAME_001]
